content_of_post_to_comment: I think this is the only perk of SM I can think of that actually helped me somehow. I use Reddit, Whatsapp (Bc of college and family), Youtube (I use it via pipe clients, so no feed, just subscriptions), Pinterest (It's more of "there's nothing else" or "i need a really specific image") and Tumblr (I feel like it's a better version of IG, FB and twitter, feels more lile a community) and sometimes I wonder how to find out those weird topics that just sparkle in may brain and later turn into character development. If wasn't for the internet, i wouldn't know about many subcultures, queer stuff, daemians... This is just what I can think on top of my head for now XP
comment: There's something underrated about discovering a niche interest before algorithms turn it into a trend. You stumble across one random post, follow a rabbit hole, and suddenly find an entire community and vocabulary you never knew existed. I think the internet is at its best when it makes the world feel bigger rather than just showing you more of what you already like.
